quality.review_scope: Source-scoped PbSe ink and ZnO nanoparticle syntheses, two precursor stocks, ZnO/electrode preparation, PbSe/ZnO device fabrication, four partial ink-concentration variants, pristine-device control and two air-storage contexts. Main 7 and SI 12 pages read in text and images. Representative characterization and device metrics do not establish exact physical batch identity. Missing recipe settings, ambiguous precursor names and conflicting printed values remain explicit; this is not a complete laboratory SOP or full-paper narrative review.
missing_fields: Exact physical batch identifiers, measured atomic coordinates and reagent supplier/grade are not reported in the admitted source.
Spin speed/time; annealing atmosphere; acquisition duration and Fourier-normalization details; exact physical batch mapping across device plots.
conflicts: Main p.4 gives23.6 µW/cm², p.5 prose22.36 µW/cm² and Figure 4/S8 legends23.64 µW/cm² for low-light conditions. These are retained as source discrepancies.

Main p.4 reports2.33×10^-14 with printed A HZ^(1/2); SI S10 ordinate is I_N² with printed A HZ^(1/2). Dimensional/normalization ambiguity remains; no corrected units or independently recomputed detectivity.
Main p.2 dark current7.6×10^-11 A differs from main p.4 7.7×10^-11 A.
